GET Performance
NT8
Tradovate
Get session performance NT8​

Returns session performance across NinjaTrader accounts through the connected CrossTrade add-on.

Endpoint​

GET /v1/api/performance

Headers​
NAME	VALUE
Authorization	Bearer <token>
Query parameters​

No parameters are required. The HTTP route also forwards optional startTime and explain query values to the add-on's SessionPerformance method. The response below documents the default request; an explanation-enabled response has not been captured.

Code examples​
Python
JavaScript
cURL
import requests



response = requests.get(

    'https://app.crosstrade.io/v1/api/performance',

    headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer my-secret-token'},

)

print(response.status_code, response.json())

Success field types​

Float fields accept whole or fractional JSON numbers. Fields in the account-row table are relative to accounts[].

FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
success	boolean	Request outcome.
epoch, sessionStart	integer	Snapshot and session-start times in Unix milliseconds.
accounts	array of objects	Per-account performance.
accounts[].accountId	integer	NT8 account ID.
accounts[].name	string	Account name.
accounts[].isConnected, accounts[].isCleanSession	boolean	Connection and session flags.
accounts[].account	object	NT8 account field grid, without root success. commissionTemplate was not present in this route's captures.
accounts[].management	object	Commission-aware management figures below.
accounts[].management.realizedProfitWithCommission, accounts[].management.realizedProfitNoCommission	float	Realized P/L with and without commission.
accounts[].management.unrealizedProfitWithCommission, accounts[].management.unrealizedProfitNoCommission	float	Unrealized P/L with and without commission.
accounts[].management.realizedCommission, accounts[].management.unrealizedCommission	float	Commission amounts.
accounts[].positionsSessionStart	array	Only empty arrays captured; populated item types remain unverified.
ACCOUNT-ROW FIELD	TYPE	DESCRIPTION
unrealizedProfitLoss, grossProfit, grossLoss, netProfit, netLiquidation	float	P/L and valuation figures.
openPositions, maxConsecutiveLoser, maxConsecutiveWinner, totalQuantity, tradesCount	integer	Position, streak, quantity and trade counts.
averageBarsInTrade, averageEntryEfficiency, averageExitEfficiency, averageTotalEfficiency	float	Trade duration and efficiency metrics.
averageTimeInMarket, longestFlatPeriod, maxTimeToRecover	string	Formatted durations.
averageTimeInMarketSerializable, longestFlatPeriodSerializable, maxTimeToRecoverSerializable	integer	Serialized duration values.
minDate, maxDate	string	Performance date bounds; may be sentinel dates when no trades exist.
monthlyStdDev, monthlyUlcer, probability, profitFactor, riskFreeReturn, rSquared, sharpeRatio, sortinoRatio	float	Statistical metrics reported by NT8.
totalCommission, totalSlippage, tradesPerDay	float	Costs, slippage and trade frequency.
needsUpdate	boolean	Performance update flag.
currency, percent	object	Metric groups. Both have the fields below.
FIELD WITHIN CURRENCY OR PERCENT	TYPE
averageEtd, averageMae, averageMfe, averageProfit	float
cumProfit, drawdown, largestLoser, largestWinner	float
profitPerMonth, stdDev, turnaround, ulcer	float
